pensamiento:
I'm checking the user story EV-31 against the criteria. The role is Agency user and the action is showing the updated date and time, which I'd count as meeting QUS-001. I'm treating "AND time" as one display element, so QUS-002 looks satisfied, and there are no extra notes that would fail QUS-003. Next I'm looking at the benefit clause, "so that I know when it was updated," for QUS-004.

Now I'm checking the remaining criteria, QUS-005 through QUS-009 and the INV checks. I'm treating the header box as the existing screen element and "updated" as the last update time, so those pass. I also note that the backlog uses English for similar stories, so the language itself isn't a defect.

I'm weighing whether the "updated" timestamp needs more definition, since it's unclear what counts as an update, but the format and the every-change behavior seem observable enough. I'm also checking whether the timestamp depends on another system's data, which isn't mentioned, and that's the open question I'm still looking at.

I'm weighing whether the timestamp comes from a backend data source that the story doesn't mention, since "updated" seems to imply one. The header already appears to show an update date, so I'm leaning toward treating DOR-001 as met, though the refresh behavior without a page reload could point to a service dependency.

I'm going through the remaining business rules, which are explicit about format, time zone, and the refresh trigger, so that checks out. The non-functional criterion doesn't apply, since a header label isn't critical or high-volume. With no defects so far, I'm leaning toward accepting the story, though I'm still deciding between a 1 and a 2 point estimate given the live update without a page reload.

I'm settling on 2 points, since the live update and time zone handling go beyond a simple rename. Next I'm drafting the refined story in Spanish, keeping the criteria and the benefit as they are, and starting the acceptance criteria list.

Next I'm writing out the acceptance criteria in Spanish: the header box shows the last update with date and time, the time appears in the user's local zone with its abbreviation, and the value refreshes on every update without reloading the page. I'm also settling the type as functional with no defects or recommendations, so the story is accepted.
